messages:
ellie_csm: Heads up team, EdgeTech confirmed preview participation but flagged two items: (1) SSO + audit logs required, (2) latency guarantees for their launch. Need a short onboarding plan and risk register.

josh_se: I can run the tech onboarding. Need EdgeTech infra contact and whether they'll do VPC peering or IP allowlist. Also ask for a small smoke dataset.

edgetech_infra: Hi all, this is Sam from EdgeTech infra. We prefer VPC peering but can do allowlist if needed. I'll share SAML metadata after legal signs the NDA (should be today). Expected peak QPS ~8, sustained ~2.

miguel_prod: Product ask: send 3 canonical prompt flows (happy path + 2 common failure modes). We'll instrument semantic-quality checks and a latency histogram. Recommend weekly 30m async review + doc update.

ellie_csm: Risk note: customer explicitly said renewal consideration will include whether we meet P95 latency < 450ms for their test queries. Flagging as high.

priya_ops: Tentative kickoff slot: Tue Apr 7 09:00 PT. I've created a calendar hold and included pre-reads: onboarding checklist, runbook, and short privacy note.

amanda_cs: I'll set up a one-question pulse after each enablement session and a weekly Typeform for deeper feedback. I'll also add a short onboarding satisfaction metric.

josh_se: Minimal pre-kickoff runbook for EdgeTech: ```
- Share SAML metadata or confirm SSO timeline
- Provide small test dataset (<= 100 rows)
- Confirm peering vs allowlist
- Share QPS/concurrency profile and any spike windows
```

finance-bot: Billing note: preview usage will be billable unless finance approves a credit. Please mark expected usage in the onboarding doc.

edgetech_infra: NDA completed. Sending SAML metadata in DM. Also attaching a small dataset for smoke tests.

miguel_prod: I'll drop an "eval template" into the shared doc: latency, token errors, top-5 failure examples, and a tiny human spot-check (5 prompts). We'll include labels for severity (info/warning/blocker).

ellie_csm: Owners: Josh -> infra validation & demo, Amanda -> feedback forms & cadence, Miguel -> eval templates & digest, Priya -> scheduling and invites, Ellie -> customer kickoff & risk escalation. I'll write a short risk register entry for the P95 SLA.

amanda_cs: Suggestion: run the pulse weekly for 3 weeks, then change cadence to biweekly for the remainder. Also add an option for in-session quick 1-5 satisfaction emoji.

josh_se: Would be useful to offer a dry-run deploy on Apr 6 22:00 UTC. Deploy team can confirm; I'll mark it as requested in the deploy channel.

ellie_csm: Please tag any blocker with "blocker:preview" in the document so ENG leadership can triage. I'll follow up with EdgeTech for any contractual clarifications on latency expectations.

priya_ops: Checklist + Zoom link uploaded: https://redwood-internal/drive/edgetech-preview-onboard. Invite updated with pre-reads and Sam is on the attendee list.

finance-bot: Noted. Finance will review the expected usage entry; ping me when you add the estimate.

miguel_prod: Adding regression triage template now. It has: reproducible steps, observed metrics, attach logs, and suggested mitigation. Keeps the weekly sync tight.

ellie_csm: Great work. I'll post a 24h pre-kickoff reminder in #customer-success. Team, please post any blockers in the doc by EOD today. :rocket:
